title: Geologic Map of the Cross Quadrangle, Berkeley, and Orangeburg Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, 2010, Geologic Map of the Cross Quadrangle, Berkeley, and Orangeburg Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-176, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR'd map sheet; map face is OCR noise. OCR misreads: 'QHiw' read as QHfw; 'Thickness | to 40 feet' read as 1 (inferred); 'clayey quartz and' read as clayey quartz sand. The 'Units in the cross section only' list (Ts, Rayzor, Ashley, Cross, Harleyville, Pringletown Beds) and section A-A' were read from page-image tiles. Holes on the section with land-surface and contact elevations read off the section's own scale (feet, relative to sea level; inferred, about +/-2 ft at this scale): 38-211, 8-307, 8-314, 8-261, 8-258, 8-336, 8-306, 8-313, 8-335, 8-324; 8-309 and 8-315 left out (drawn over the lake or without legible contacts). Several holes are drawn dashed with tops above the section profile (perhaps projected); noted per hole. The section marks the Cross/Ts contact with '?'. Former Carolina bay sand rims and Dorchester Scarp appear in the legend; not recorded. Contact and drill hole symbol from the legend only. SUBSURFACE: none beyond the recorded values.
